_comment: Paired host acceptance screen of task T0077: exact-count RL policy specialists (S = agent_v2_rl_csp) vs compute-matched general control (G = agent_v2_rl_general_csp) vs common initialization baseline (I = agent_v2_rl_init_csp) + A/A copy of S. Fresh seed 20262101, exactly 8 workers, 2,000 ms first and 50 ms steady replies. 96 maps per count across counts 2-15 (1,344 fixtures, 5,376 games total across 4 arms). Primary S-G and supporting G-I form one two-contrast Bonferroni family (alpha=0.05).
